items.title: AI Arsenal Digest — 2026-07
items.summary: July 2026 digest: 15 new benchmark entries across all 7 categories, a formal Trending vertical (5 commits), and a rounded-out Skills curriculum with 4 learning paths and 8 guides.
highlights: 15 new benchmark entries added across all 7 categories (code, agents, safety, multimodal, evaluation-methods) — total benchmarks now 30
Trending promoted to a first-class `trend` entry type with schema, taxonomy, migration guard, and CI enforcement (5 commits)
Skills curriculum now ships 4 learning paths and 8 guides; the previously-empty `by-role` section is populated
